project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to be a complex system handling exam-related processes, including form submissions, results management, and user interaction. The application is structured around multiple views, each representing a specific stage or component within the exam workflow. The dependency graph reveals a significant reliance on routing and data transfer between these views. The project's architecture demonstrates an attempt to modularize functionality but may be susceptible to complexity issues as it expands.

layers.description: Handles user interface rendering and interactions.
Contains the core application logic and processing.

macro_trends.title: Potential UI/UX Contamination
macro_trends.description: Several views (e.g., ApplicationServices, ResultPage, ExamFormSubmission) import UI-related components and Accessibility patterns. This could introduce inconsistencies across the application’s design and potentially increase UI maintenance costs. Careful review of these import statements is needed to establish a robust UI/UX standard.

macro_trends.title: Routing Fragility
macro_trends.description: The heavily utilized Router navigation flows may create a fragile dependency structure. Changes in routing pathways could cause cascading changes throughout related views.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves a user completing an exam form (ExamFormSubmission.vue), submitting the data, and viewing the results (ResultPage.vue) and marksheet (viewMarksheet.vue). Routing handles the transition between these stages, and data flows between views to manage the submission process.

key_workflows.name: User Authentication and Authorization
key_workflows.description: The application utilizes a SelectedApplicationService.vue, likely handling user authentication, authorization, and role-based access control. The impact of this functionality on other views needs further investigation.
